definitions.full: H2628. chasal [ חָסַל ] verb finish off, consume (Aramaic חֲסַל come to an end , Aph`el bring to an end ) — Qal Imperfect הָאַרְבֶּה יַחְסְלֶנּוּ Deut 28:38 of locusts destroying crops.
